{{Top|leg}}
'''Synthweavers''' were people who fabricated synthetic materials out of [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], chemicals and artifact pieces to build [[Armor/Legends|armor]] for [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. At the time of the [[Galactic War]] between [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], synthweaving was predominant across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Some [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] provided premade solutions and composites that were used during the fabrication process.
